outcome: Estimated blood loss (EBL) during cesarean delivery
Rate of iodoform gauze packing of the uterine cavity
cohort: Pregnant women with pernicious placenta previa complicated with placenta accrete undergoing cesarean delivery
finding: IIA and AA occlusions had similar hemostatic effects in the overall cohort, but AA occlusion was more effective in reducing EBL in the placenta percreta subgroup.
